subject: BlueWave Leadership Summit — sponsorship credit triage & playbook
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Thompson <sara@bluewaveanalytics.com>, EventWorks Operations <ops@eventworksagency.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: BlueWave Leadership Summit — sponsorship credit triage & playbook

Hi Sara / EventWorks team,

Thanks again for sponsoring the Leadership Summit last week. We ran an initial reconciliation this morning and found a mismatch between the leads BlueWave reports as "sponsored MQLs" and what our attribution pipeline attached to the sponsor credit in HubSpot. Attached are two files to start: BW-leads-raw.csv (the full event form captures + meeting opt-ins) and sponsorship-mop.pdf (how Redwood assigns sponsor credits).

Quick ask: could you send the version of your rollup that maps the 21 leads you reported as "sponsored SQLs" (we only see 13 mapped to the sponsor) and any rules you used to classify? If it's easier, a short call with EventWorks ops + our sales ops (Ben) to walk the mapping would save time.

Proposed immediate steps from our side:
- Ben: export of HubSpot contact timestamps and lead source path (attached csv).
- Laura: run reconciliation on revenue-credited opportunities tied to event leads.
- Aditya: draft a short triage playbook for consistent sponsor crediting going forward (first draft attached).

I've looped in Ben and Laura to keep this internal for now until we reconcile the numbers. Please send your spreadsheet and any notes on de-dupe + meeting-vs-form rules by EOD so we can put an agreed rollup in writing.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Field Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BW-leads-raw.csv (csv), sponsorship-mop.pdf (pdf)

From: Sara Thompson <sara@bluewaveanalytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: EventWorks Operations <ops@eventworksagency.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BlueWave Leadership Summit — sponsorship credit triage & playbook

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for sending this over. Quick context from our side: our count focuses on meeting-confirmations that had an explicit "sponsor follow-up" checkbox filled during booking + any inbound demo requests the SDR marked as sponsor-originated in their notes. That leads to the 21 number. I attached our export (bluewave-attribution.xlsx) with a tab that flags how we counted.

A few immediate notes:
- We de-duplicated by email, but we kept leads if there was a separate meeting booked (even if the CTI form was the same).
- We included a small set (n=3) of partners that signed up onsite via badge-scan and were manually added to CRM; those were labeled "manual-scan" in our sheet.
- We did not apply a revenue qualification step — that was left to your SDR/opportunity process.

We'd be happy to join a short call to align definitions. Tomorrow morning our VP of Partnerships is away, but Sara (me) and Ops from EventWorks are available between 11:00-13:00 PT.

Best,
Sara Thompson
Head of Partnerships
BlueWave Analytics

Attachment: bluewave-attribution.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: BlueWave Leadership Summit — sponsorship credit triage & playbook

Aditya / team,

I pulled the HubSpot exports and did a quick reconciliation against BW-leads-raw.csv — attaching a stripped down delta (final-credit-rollup.csv). Observations:
- 8 contacts BlueWave flagged as "sponsored" have their first-touch recorded as "webinar-form" with an earlier acquisition timestamp — those are being attributed to the webinar route, not the sponsorship.
- 3 manual-scan entries from BlueWave are in HubSpot but lack the "sponsor" campaign tag because EventWorks uploaded them under a generic import job.
- There are 6 records where the meeting was booked under the rep's personal calendaring link and therefore bypassed the tracking parameter EventWorks uses.

I agree a short call to standardize the rule set will save back-and-forth. Proposed canonical rules for sponsor credit (draft):
1) If form submission includes sponsor checkbox, sponsor gets credit unless an earlier paid campaign has an earlier timestamp.
2) If meeting booked and meets "sponsor follow-up" checkbox, sponsor gets primary credit.
3) Manual-badges are credited when import job includes sponsor_campaign metadata.

I'll be on the call and can have these rules pushed as a short playbook doc by EOD.

-Ben
Senior Sales Operations Analyst
Redwood Inference

Attachment: final-credit-rollup.csv (csv)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: BlueWave Leadership Summit — sponsorship credit triage & playbook

Quick note — when I ran the revenue rollforward, three opportunities that BlueWave expects to be associated to the sponsor are currently tied to two different AE owners (internal) because the opportunity creation used the rep's direct outreach flow. We need to confirm whether the sponsor wishes those opps to be re-assigned (we can do internal crediting without owner reassignment but that affects AE comp). Also: Priyom, can you check whether any closed-won in the set had an invoice uplift tied to a partner discount?

If BlueWave wants the revenue ownership moved for reporting, we should confirm in writing. I'll hold off touching any ownership fields until we have a mutual agreement.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Thompson <sara@bluewaveanalytics.com>, EventWorks Operations <ops@eventworksagency.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: BlueWave Leadership Summit — sponsorship credit triage & playbook

Sara / EventWorks — thanks for the quick turnaround and the spreadsheet. We're aligned enough to move to a short audit window. Agreed next steps and timeline below: 

1) By EOD 11/02: BlueWave to confirm the authoritative list for the 21 sponsor-flagged contacts (Sara) and call out any manual-scan rows.
2) By EOD 11/02: EventWorks to re-run the import with sponsor_campaign metadata for manual-scan rows and share the import job id.
3) By 11/03 10:00 PT: 30-min alignment call (Aditya / Ben / Laura / Grace / Sara / EventWorks) to sign the canonical rules for sponsor crediting. Calendar invite linked here: https://cal.redwoodinference.com/meet/bluewave-credit-audit
4) By 11/05: Redwood to produce an agreed final-credit-rollup.csv and a one-page sponsor credit playbook (triage-playbook-v1.docx attached). This will be the version we use for reporting and invoicing.

Laura — regarding owner reassignment, agreed we won't change AE ownership without written consent from BlueWave. We'll provide a reporting-only mapping so your comp/finance processes are unaffected. Priyom — please flag any contracts with partner discount clauses that would alter invoice value.

I'll set the alignment call for tomorrow at 11:30 PT (tentative) if that works for everyone; will update the invite once I have confirmation.

Thanks all — we'll aim to close this by the end of the week so BlueWave has final numbers for their internal ROI deck.

Aditya Rao
Head of Field Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: triage-playbook-v1.docx (docx)
